# `conductor`

Generated by `conductor-docs` from the clap definition of the `conductor` command line in [`crates/conductor/src/cli.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/conductor/blob/main/crates/conductor/src/cli.rs). It lists only commands that exist; `--help` after any command prints the same text.

> The records conductor and the repository controllers keep

## Global options

Every command takes these, before or after its name.

| Argument | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--state-dir <DIR>` | no | none | The state directory; conductor's records are kept in its tree/. Default: the instance's state when a config file names it, else state/ under the working directory |
| `--config <FILE>` | no | none | The config file, named by `globals.config` of the binding. Default: $CONDUCTOR_CONFIG, else ~/.b10x/conductor/conductor.yaml. Every command reads it for its instance |

## `conductor decision escalate-request`

Escalate a decision request

```text
Usage: conductor decision escalate-request [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | none | RequestId |
| `--escalation-class <ESCALATION_CLASS>` | no | none | DecisionClass One of `C`, `O`, `H`. |
| `--reason <REASON>` | no | none | string |
| `--dry-run <FILE>` | no | none | The file holding the dry run: what every step of the operator's script that needs no credential printed. A class-H escalation carries this or `--no-dry-run` |
| `--no-dry-run <REASON>` | no | none | Why the operator's script has no dry run. A class-H escalation carries this or `--dry-run` |
| `--kind <KIND>` | no | none | RequestKind: how the operator answers. Required for class O One of `yes-no`, `one-of`, `several-of`. |
| `--lettered-options <LETTERED_OPTIONS>` | no | none | list of RequestOption, a JSON array of `{letter, label, cost}`; `Y` and `N` for `yes-no`. Required for class O |
| `--recommended-letters <LETTERS>` | no | none | The letter conductor recommends, or several joined by `,` for `several-of`. Required for class O |
| `--default-letters <LETTERS>` | no | none | The letter that stands when the operator has not answered by the deadline, or several joined by `,` for `several-of`. Required for class O |
| `--deadline <DEADLINE>` | no | none | timestamp, RFC 3339: when the default stands. Required for class O |
| `--input-json <INPUT_JSON>` | no | none | Read the input fields from standard input, as one JSON object One of `-`. |

## `conductor build run`

Reserve disk for a command's expected peak in the host ledger, reclaiming first when it does not fit; run it in its own process group under the disk watchdog, record its peak, release the reservation when it exits or is killed, and exit with its status; exit 2 naming the shortfall when reclaim cannot reach the size

```text
Usage: conductor build run [OPTIONS] [-- <COMMAND>...]
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--reserve <SIZE>` | no | none | The command's expected peak, in GiB: `8G`, or `8` |
| `--repository <REPOSITORY>` | no | none | The repository the command builds, recorded with the reservation |
| `<COMMAND>` | no | none | The command and its arguments, after `--` |

## `conductor watch run`

Watch sessions, usage limits, conductor's context, free disk and main's CI; exit after the first pass that finds a change

```text
Usage: conductor watch run [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Meaning |
